description: Header file defining the TunerAdministrator singleton class, which manages tuner instances and notifications within a broadcast system. It includes nested classes, callback interfaces, and methods for registration, deregistration, and state management of tuners.

classes.name: TunerAdministrator
classes.description: Singleton class managing tuner instances and observer notifications, providing registration, deregistration, and state change handling.

classes.name: TunerAdministrator::ICallback
classes.description: Interface for callback objects to receive tuner state change notifications.

classes.name: TunerAdministrator::Sink
classes.description: Private nested class implementing ICallback, forwarding state change notifications to the parent TunerAdministrator.

methods.name: Instance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of TunerAdministrator.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers an observer for tuner notifications and immediately notifies it of current tuners.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Removes an observer from the notification list.

methods.name: Announce
methods.description: Registers a new tuner, notifies observers, and returns a callback sink.

methods.name: Revoke
methods.description: Removes a tuner and notifies observers of its deactivation.

methods.name: StateChange
methods.description: Notifies all observers of a tuner state change.
